subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils 4/7] nfsdctl: add rpcbind registration helpers

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch adds rpcbind registration helpers to the nfsdctl utility, allowing it to register and unregister NFS services with the local rpcbind. The code ensures that only valid registrations are made, based on rules defined by the kernel's behavior. The patch also moves the struct server_socket definition to a new header file and updates the Makefile to include the new files.
